title: I never include homework in calculation of grades. Measures behavior not competency, but when students didn't reach mastery on assessments it was easy
summary: I never include homework in calculation of grades. Measures behavior not competency, but when students didn't reach mastery on assessments it was easy to show parents a record of homework incompletion and have discussions of behaviors that lead to mastery. #satchat
author: Greg McVerry
